lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Unit performance task: who to call and how, before it is needed

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic who to call and how, before it is needed task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: Combining the skills from this unit (scheduling, private record-keeping, describing a concern clearly, and recognizing urgency), the learner builds one reference plan: a contact list template organized by type of need, a short description of where and how personal records will be kept, and the learner's own version of the urgency rule from earlier in the unit.
safetyNotes: The finished plan is a reference template -- it does not include any real diagnosis, medication, symptom detail, or account/insurance numbers.
Contact list entries are limited to role and where to find how to reach them (for example, 'primary care office -- number kept in phone contacts'), not sensitive account details.

simulationAlternative.description: If a guardian isn't available right now to review the plan together, the learner instead completes the full plan independently and then writes a short explanation of who they believe would be the right person to review it with and what they would ask that person to confirm.

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Now that the plan exists, what is the one part you're most likely to actually use in the next few months, and why?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Plan completeness across the three parts: All three parts are present and each reflects skills built earlier in the unit. | Appropriate level of detail (role and location, not real private detail): Every entry uses a role-and-location format with no real private detail. | Guardian review substance: Guardian confirmation includes at least one specific point about what's realistic, or not, for the household. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner add one additional contact type not already covered (for example, a counseling resource or a specialist) and write the same role-and-location entry for it.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic who to call and how, before it is needed task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: 10–20 minutes for permission, required supervision or review, and physical-event attestation

localMaterials.label: paper or notes app
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: who to call and how, before it is needed coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Combining the skills from this unit (scheduling, private record-keeping, describing a concern clearly, and recognizing urgency), the learner builds one reference plan: a contact list template organized by type of need, a short description of where and how personal records will be kept, and the learner's own version of the urgency rule from earlier in the unit.
Coach direction: Before building the plan, gather what you already have from this unit.

Learner prompt: Looking back at this unit, which piece (record-keeping categories, describing a concern, or recognizing urgency) do you feel most confident about already, and which do you still want this plan to help with?
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: who to call and how, before it is needed complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Build the three parts of your personal health-management plan.

Response 1 (t2-p1): Build a contact list template organized by type of need (for example: routine/preventive care, urgent concerns, questions between visits). For each type, name the role of who to contact and where the actual contact information is kept -- not the real contact information itself.
Response 2 (t2-p2): Write a short description of how your personal records will be kept: what categories, where stored, and who can see them, building on the template from earlier in this unit.
Response 3 (t2-p3): Write your own short version of the urgency rule from earlier in this unit: what signs mean 'seek help now' versus 'can wait,' in your own words.

Equal-access rule: If a guardian isn't available right now to review the plan together, the learner instead completes the full plan independently and then writes a short explanation of who they believe would be the right person to review it with and what they would ask that person to confirm.

resources.title: who to call and how, before it is needed minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Now that the plan exists, what is the one part you're most likely to actually use in the next few months, and why?

Success checks: Plan completeness across the three parts: All three parts are present and each reflects skills built earlier in the unit. | Appropriate level of detail (role and location, not real private detail): Every entry uses a role-and-location format with no real private detail. | Guardian review substance: Guardian confirmation includes at least one specific point about what's realistic, or not, for the household.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: who to call and how, before it is needed supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional who to call and how, before it is needed condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Plan completeness across the three parts: All three parts are present and each reflects skills built earlier in the unit. | Appropriate level of detail (role and location, not real private detail): Every entry uses a role-and-location format with no real private detail. | Guardian review substance: Guardian confirmation includes at least one specific point about what's realistic, or not, for the household..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

realRoute.title: who to call and how, before it is needed — permitted real-life route
realRoute.permissionRule: Do not begin the physical action until a household-authorized guardian gives permission and is available for the supervision or review named in this lesson.
steps: Confirm the setting, materials, and stop condition before acting.
Build the three parts of your personal health-management plan.
Complete the response prompts on the delivered independent card without recording private identifying details.
Check the result against the delivered evidence record and correct any missed step.
realRoute.completionCondition: The learner submits the minimal process record; only the household-authorized guardian attests that the named physical action occurred.

simulationRoute.directions: If a guardian isn't available right now to review the plan together, the learner instead completes the full plan independently and then writes a short explanation of who they believe would be the right person to review it with and what they would ask that person to confirm.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

evidence.reflectionPrompt: Now that the plan exists, what is the one part you're most likely to actually use in the next few months, and why?

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Plan completeness across the three parts: All three parts are present and each reflects skills built earlier in the unit. | Appropriate level of detail (role and location, not real private detail): Every entry uses a role-and-location format with no real private detail. | Guardian review substance: Guardian confirmation includes at least one specific point about what's realistic, or not, for the household.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g11-u03-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
